projection.display: Top-down x/y projection; source z is retained but is not used as a visibility cut
projection.ruler: The map ruler measures projected x/y separation, not full three-dimensional separation

gaia_dr3_epoch_2026_00_proper_motion_coo.coordinate_frame: ICRS astrometry transformed to heliocentric ecliptic Cartesian coordinates
gaia_dr3_epoch_2026_00_proper_motion_coo.position_epoch: J2026.0 where a complete proper-motion vector is available; otherwise J2016.0
gaia_dr3_epoch_2026_00_proper_motion_coo.selection_caveat: Positive-parallax quality-selected atlas subset; it is not a complete stellar census.

heasarc_neargalcat_j2000_distance_coordi.coordinate_frame: J2000 equatorial coordinates transformed to heliocentric ecliptic Cartesian coordinates
heasarc_neargalcat_j2000_distance_coordi.selection_caveat: A literature compilation of nearby galaxies, not a uniform all-sky volume-limited survey.

catalog_redshift_comoving.coordinate_frame: ICRS RA/Dec transformed to heliocentric ecliptic Cartesian coordinates
catalog_redshift_comoving.position_epoch: Catalog sky position; no proper-motion propagation

cosmology.name: flat LambdaCDM
cosmology.parameters: H0=67.66 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.30966, Omega_lambda=0.69034; line-of-sight comoving distance

catalog_redshift_comoving.selection_caveat: Successful DESI spectra within the DESI footprint and pipeline target/class cuts; blank sky can be outside the footprint.

catalog_inferred_redshift_comoving.coordinate_frame: Gaia/ICRS sky position transformed to heliocentric ecliptic Cartesian coordinates
catalog_inferred_redshift_comoving.catalog_epoch: Quaia catalog based on Gaia DR3 positions

cosmology.name: flat LambdaCDM
cosmology.parameters: H0=67.66 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.30966, Omega_lambda=0.69034; line-of-sight comoving distance

catalog_inferred_redshift_comoving.selection_caveat: G<20 quasar-candidate sample with inferred spectrophotometric/ML redshifts; not spectroscopy and not spatially complete.

jpl_sbdb_two_body_osculating_elements.coordinate_frame: Heliocentric ecliptic state derived from JPL SBDB osculating elements
jpl_sbdb_two_body_osculating_elements.selection_caveat: Two-body propagation is contextual and is not an orbit-determination or mission-planning product.

openngc_j2000_coordinates.projection: A spatial position is exposed only when OpenNGC supplies a class-appropriate distance
openngc_j2000_coordinates.selection_caveat: OpenNGC Pax is not treated as parallax for galaxies. Galactic classes never use Hubble-flow redshift or radial-velocity distance, and radial velocity alone is never converted to distance.
